* fix(bridge): poll desktop WeAuto threads and match real message fields

Desktop WeAuto emits no message.committed events, so inbound now polls
/threads/{id}/messages per allowed chat with persisted anchors (INBOUND_MODE=sse
keeps the stream path). Accept direction=inbound, detect @bot through
mentions.userIds against the account wxid, and derive media MIME from the
content response or file magic when the asset contentType is null.
